maddeler.e:
أتفاضل (form VI)
# أَتَفَاضَلُ (ʔatafāḍalu) /ʔa.ta.faː.dˤa.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# أَتَفَاضَلَ (ʔatafāḍala) /ʔa.ta.faː.dˤa.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
# أَتَفَاضَلْ (ʔatafāḍal) /ʔa.ta.faː.dˤal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَفَاضَلَ (tafāḍala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
